description: This is a Java source file defining the ContactManager activity in an Android application. It manages contact list display, adding new contacts, and filtering visible contacts based on user interactions with UI controls.

classes.name: ContactManager
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a list of contacts, allows adding new contacts, and filtering the list based on visibility.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, and event handlers.

methods.name: populateContactList
methods.description: Queries contacts and populates the ListView with contact display names.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Builds and executes a query to retrieve contacts based on visibility filter.

methods.name: launchContactAdder
methods.description: Starts the ContactAdder activity to add a new contact.
